title: AC corona aging behavior and performance comparison of HTV silicone rubber, cycloaliphatic epoxy resin, and glass fiber-reinforced epoxy used in composite insulators
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31884-31898
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05182G, Paper

Cycloaliphatic epoxy resin demonstrates strong aging resistance, stability, and electrical performance, offering a promising alternative to silicone rubber for rigid insulator housings in high-voltage harsh environments.
